Room.title: Room
Room.description: A collaborative workspace room containing note content, role-based participant permissions, real ownership metadata, and active presence.

workspaceId.description: Unique identifier of the workspace room.

roomCode.description: Human readable unique room code (e.g. LP-7XK9-MQ2P).

workspaceType.description: Category of workspace setting default permissions and participant roles.

workspaceName.description: Human-friendly display name of the workspace.

ownerId.description: UID of the registered Workspace Owner.

ownerName.description: Display name of the registered Workspace Owner.

createdBy.description: UID of the original workspace creator.

creatorId.description: UID of the user who created the workspace.

workspaceRoleVersion.description: Version number for the RBAC permission engine (e.g., 2).

creatorRole.description: Assigned administrative role of the workspace creator.

participantLimit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous participants allowed in the workspace.

participants.description: Map of user IDs to participant details including role, joinedAt, and status.

content.description: The text content of the live notepad.

createdAt.description: The server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: The server timestamp when content was last updated.

users.description: A map of user IDs to active user presence details (name, active, joinedAt).

typingUsers.description: A map of user IDs to boolean or timestamp values indicating typing status.

attachments.description: A list of file/media attachments or web/shared links recorded in this room.

label.description: An optional label/category tag assigned to the notepad room.

title.description: Document title override for the notepad.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: An immutable audit log entry recording an administrative or permission action in the workspace.

HistoryEntry.title: HistoryEntry
HistoryEntry.description: An edit history entry mapping previous states of the room content.

content.description: The historical note content at this specific entry.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when this entry was created.

authorName.description: The nickname of the editing author.

CodingProject.title: CodingProject
CodingProject.description: A coding project inside a workspace.

ProjectFolder.title: ProjectFolder
ProjectFolder.description: A directory folder within a coding project.

ProjectFile.title: ProjectFile
ProjectFile.description: A code or asset file within a project.

FileVersion.title: FileVersion
FileVersion.description: Historical snapshot of a project file.

TrashedItem.title: TrashedItem
TrashedItem.description: A soft-deleted file or folder in project trash.

rooms/{roomId}.description: Active workspace rooms with real-time text, role permissions, and status syncing.

rooms/{roomId}/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Audit trail log entries for administrative workspace actions.

rooms/{roomId}/history/{historyId}.description: The edit history snapshots for a room.

rooms/{roomId}/projects/{projectId}/file.description: Version history snapshots for a code file.

rooms/{roomId}/projects/{projectId}/tras.description: Recycle bin items for a project.
